    • getPlanregistratiesForProvincie

      @Transactional(readOnly=true, isolation=REPEATABLE_READ) public List<Planregistratie> getPlanregistratiesForProvincie(boolean withAantallen)
      Returns all planregistraties, with the aantallen if requested. Uses a repeatable read transaction so the aantallen are consistent with the planregistraties.

    • insertPlanregistratie

      @Transactional public void insertPlanregistratie(Planregistratie planregistratie, String username) throws org.locationtech.jts.io.ParseException
      Inserts a planregistratie or replaces an existing one, including the aantallen. The creator, createdAt, editor and editedAt fields of the planregistratie are set from the username and the current time, the values from the client are ignored. For an existing planregistratie the creator and createdAt are kept.
      Throws:
      org.locationtech.jts.io.ParseException
